about_the_game:
Move and win in "Movement Gods", a third-person online shooter based on advanced movement mechanics. The action takes place in the distant future, where robots are fighting for glory on the remnants of human civilization!

ADVANCED MECHANICS

Do you miss dynamic battles? In Movement Gods, you will have to move like the floor is lava! Discover the mechanics to find the best way to survive in this challenging world!

VARIETY OF WEAPONS

Each weapon has its own characteristics. You can fire a blasting pistol, toss kunai at your enemies, and deflect projectiles with your katana! Choose weapons to suit your style and destroy your opponents!

UNIQUE UNIVERSE

Learn about the future world, in which humans no longer hold a place.

SKILL-BASED PVP

Use mechanics and a variety of weapons to snatch victory from the hands of your opponents!

UPGRADE YOUR CHARACTER

Participate in battles and get paid. Buy skills and weapons to become stronger!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or higher
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)

short_description: Movement Gods is a third-person online shooter where your skill determines everything! Enter the battle, fight, search for new weapons and modules! Improve your skills to become the ultimate Movement God!
